title: Tytuł
name: Imię lub pseudonim
connected: Połączono w celu utworzenia kopii zapasowej na Dysku Google
alreadyImported: Ta kopia zapasowa została już zaimportowana
error: Operacja nie powiodła się. Twoje dane nie zostały usunięte.
saveError: Nie zapisano. Pozostaw tę stronę otwartą i spróbuj zapisać ponownie.
trashConfirm: Przenieść do kosza? Możesz go przywrócić później.
permanentConfirm: Usunąć trwale? Wybranej zawartości nie można odzyskać z kosza.
restoreConfirm: Przywrócić tę wersję? Obecna wersja pozostaje w historii.
noNotifications: W tym terminie nie wysyła się powiadomienia.
freeOffline: Darmowe notatki i zadania do wykonania. Działa w trybie offline.
backupExplanation: Zaszyfrowane kopie zapasowe na Twoim Dysku Google. Pliki lokalne działają bez konta.
backupManual: Tworzenie kopii zapasowych rozpoczyna się po naciśnięciu przycisku. Poprzednie kopie na Dysku zostaną zachowane.
privacySummary: Notatki pozostają na Twoim urządzeniu. Na żądanie przesyłane są tylko zaszyfrowane kopie zapasowe.
passwordWarning: Użyj co najmniej 12 znaków. Zachowaj to hasło w bezpiecznym miejscu: bez niego nowy telefon nie będzie mógł otworzyć kopii zapasowej.
passwordPrompt: Wprowadź hasło użyte podczas tworzenia tej kopii zapasowej.
passwordRule: Użyj hasła składającego się z co najmniej 12 znaków.
backupError: Tworzenie kopii zapasowej nie powiodło się. Sprawdź swoje hasło, plik, połączenie internetowe i dostęp do Dysku, a następnie spróbuj ponownie.
googleSetup: Połączenie Google nie jest skonfigurowane dla tej kompilacji. Zobacz plik GOOGLE_SETUP.md.
accountMismatch: Ta kopia zapasowa należy do innego konta Google.
accountSwitchConfirm: Używać tego konta Google do lokalnych danych w tym telefonie? Przyszłe kopie zapasowe będą trafiać na to konto.
disconnectConfirm: Odłączyć Google? Notatki lokalne i istniejące kopie zapasowe na Dysku pozostaną.
restoreMerge: Zaimportować do oddzielnych folderów? Istniejące dane pozostają niezmienione. Powtarzanie tego samego importu nie dodaje duplikatów.
lockUnavailable: Najpierw skonfiguruj blokadę ekranu w ustawieniach telefonu.
xPurchaseInfo: Your purchase can be restored with the same Google Play account. No subscription.
xMoneyJournalInfo: Personal records and reports only. No bank connection, card payments or money transfers.
xExternal: Open this link in another app? That service may receive your request.
xPlainExport: Export an unencrypted copy outside Bilga? Anyone with access to that file can read it.
xModelInfo: Local AI. Download the model first, then test this device before purchasing. Answers may be wrong. Text stays on this device.
xUnsupported: This device does not currently meet the requirements. More RAM and storage are required.
xMediaLocalBackup: Attachments require a complete local .bilga2 backup. Export it from Settings; Drive backup is not used for these files.
xChatInfo: The conversation is cleared when you leave this page. Actions require your confirmation.
hEncourage: A missed day does not erase what you have learned. Start again with a small step. Paused days do not earn a completion.
turboDeferred: Optional local AI is not included in this lightweight build. It is not offered for purchase here.
gNetwork: No connection or the request timed out. Your local data is still available. Try again when connected.
gCanceled: Sign-in was not completed. Try again. If this repeats, check the app signing SHA and Web client ID.
gAuth: Google authorization failed or expired. Connect your Google account again.
gPermission: Drive refused access. Grant Drive permission; the developer must also enable Drive API and verify OAuth setup.
gUnavailable: Google Drive is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
tagDuplicate: Tag o tej nazwie już istnieje.
tagDeleteConfirm: Usunąć ten tag z biblioteki i wszystkich notatek? Notatki zostaną zachowane.
widgetApprove: Potwierdzam, że te notatki nie zawierają prywatnych informacji
widgetPrivacyInfo: Launcher może zapisać tekst i wyświetlić go na ekranie blokady. Wybierz tylko jawne notatki. Zmieniony tekst wymaga ponownego zatwierdzenia. Nie można zagwarantować usunięcia kopii zapisanych wcześniej przez program uruchamiający Androida.
widgetPermissionHint: Włącz „Zezwól na wyświetlanie w widżecie” na karcie notatki. Domyślnie wyłączone.
reminderOverlayInfo: Opcjonalnie: zezwól na przypomnienia nad innymi aplikacjami w ustawieniach Androida. Powiadomienia działają bez tej zgody.
reminderPrivacy: Tytuły mogą zobaczyć inni, a program uruchamiający może je zapisać także na ekranie blokady. Zezwalaj tylko na niewrażliwy tekst. Usunięcie starych kopii nie jest gwarantowane.
reminderLimits: Android może opóźniać przypomnienia lub ukrywać panele. Sprawdź powiadomienia, dokładne alarmy i baterię; wyskakujące powiadomienie nie jest gwarantowane.
widgetNotesUnavailable: Notatki nie są jeszcze dostępne. Odblokuj Bilga lub urządzenie i spróbuj ponownie. Uprawnienia widżetu zostaną zachowane.
readOnlyInfo: Reading and exporting remain available. A lifetime purchase is required to create or edit after the trial.
searchAssistantInfo: Offline text search shows excerpts from your own records with links to their sources. It does not generate answers or change your data.
lifetimeInfo: One payment. Lifetime access. No subscription, ads, or automatic charge.
plannerReminderInfo: A task due date and a notification reminder are separate. Configure reminders in the task editor.
trialIntroduction: Use Bilga free for 40 days. Then unlock lifetime access with one payment. No subscription or automatic charge.
trialUnavailable: Trial status could not be read. Retry; your data is preserved.
trialClock: The device date moved backwards. Enable automatic date and time, then retry.
debugTrialInfo: DEBUG · Trial scenario only · No paid entitlement
purchaseNotConfigured: Google Play purchase is not configured in this build. Trial, reading and exports remain available.
purchasePending: Payment is pending. Access unlocks after Google Play confirms completion.
purchaseRevoked: The purchase was revoked. Your data is preserved.
purchaseVerification: Purchase could not be verified. Try Restore purchases later. Your active trial continues.
purchaseAcknowledgement: Access is saved; Google Play acknowledgement will be retried. Use Restore purchases when online.
purchaseUnavailable: Google Play is temporarily unavailable. Your active trial and verified access are preserved.
richInvalidLink: Enter a valid https, http or email link.
richUnsupported: This formatting cannot be edited in this version. Your original text and formatting are preserved; you can read or export the note.
repeatInvalidInterval: Choose a whole interval from 1 to 365.
repeatInvalidEnd: End date must be on or after the first occurrence.
repeatDueRequired: Choose a due date before repeating this task.
repeatFuture: Apply changes to this and future occurrences
repeatOnly: Other edits affect only this occurrence.
repeatHistorical: This is a past occurrence. Manage the schedule from the current task.
repeatExplain: The original schedule is kept. Completing an overdue occurrence skips missed dates.
repeatReopen: Reopen the completed task to change its schedule.
repeatClearDue: Turn off repeat before removing the due date.
taskTemplateEmpty: Save a task as a template or create one here.
taskTemplateDeleteInfo: Delete this template? Tasks already created from it stay unchanged.
taskTemplateIndependent: Each use creates an independent task with unchecked subtasks. Dates, reminders and widget consent are not copied.
taskProjectStatusInfo: Project status is separate from task completion. Task deadlines and reminders stay unchanged.
taskProjectRemoveInfo: Remove project details? Nested lists and tasks stay unchanged.
fAccountArchiveInfo: Balances and history are preserved. Archived accounts remain in totals.
fAccountLocalInfo: These are local records. Transfers use this ledger’s currency and do not move bank money or convert currencies.
fAccountReconcileInfo: Reconciliation adds a dated adjustment to match an observed balance. It is excluded from income and expense reports.
fAccountNeedActive: Create or restore an active account first.
fAccountMatched: Balance already matched; no monetary adjustment.
fTransactionCurrent: The current transaction is shown above. History keeps the state before each change.
fTransactionRestoreInfo: Restore this saved transaction? Other transactions remain as they are. The current state will also be kept in history.
fDebtHasRepayments: This debt has repayments. Undo those repayments before undoing the debt.
fTransactionUndoInfo: Update this transaction’s effect on balances? Its saved states remain in history.
fReportInfo: Transfers cancel out. Loans, repayments and balance adjustments do not count as income or expenses. Opening balances are shown separately.
fReportRangeError: Choose a shorter period (up to 3,660 days).
bTitleInvalid: Enter a title of up to 200 characters.
bIsbnInvalid: Enter a valid ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, or leave it empty.
bPageInvalid: The current page cannot exceed the total pages.
bLabelsInvalid: Use up to 50 labels, each up to 100 characters.
bDatesInvalid: Use valid dates; the finish must not precede the start.
bLabelsInfo: Separate names with commas or new lines.
gMissing: You can scroll to the control or exit the guide and continue normally.
hgAbout: Build a routine you can keep. Choose your days, track a small action or a quantity, and see your progress over time.
hgHow: Choose a template or create your own habit. For a yes/no habit, keep the target at 1. For reading or walking, choose a quantity and unit. Check in today or correct an earlier day using its calendar chip. A scheduled missed day breaks the streak; a deliberate pause does not earn a completion.
hgSafe: The guide works offline. It uses the real editor and never saves for you. Only Save creates a habit. Skip or Exit closes the guidance without discarding your draft.
hgRestart: An unfinished guide is available. After an app restart, we start with the name again because unsaved form drafts are not stored.
hgTitle: Enter a name for your habit in the highlighted field. When finished, tap Next. Nothing is saved yet.
hgSchedule: Choose the weekdays when you want to practice. Selected days are highlighted. Keep every day selected for a daily habit, then tap Next.
hgTarget: Keep 1 for a yes/no habit, or enter your daily quantity, such as 10 for reading. Then tap Next.
hgSave: Review your choices. Tap the highlighted Save button when ready. The guide advances only after the habit is saved successfully; errors keep your draft.
hgProgress: Your habit is saved. Today shows completed habits out of those scheduled for today. Use Check in for a quantity; calendar days let you correct history. Mark a day only after you actually practice.
htPreviewNotice: These are editable suggestions. Previewing or choosing one creates no habit. Customize the form and tap Save when you are ready.
htWhy_water: Keep a simple record of the amount you choose to drink.
htWhy_walk: Make room for a short walk that fits your day.
htWhy_exercise: Choose a realistic movement routine on selected days.
htWhy_sleep: Choose a bedtime and reflect on keeping it.
htWhy_stretch: Add a short movement break to your routine.
htWhy_read: Protect a little time for reading each day.
htWhy_math: Practice a few problems and track your study time.
htWhy_language: Practice vocabulary, listening or speaking consistently.
htWhy_lessons: Return to what you learned before it fades.
htWhy_study: Reserve a focused study block on weekdays.
htWhy_plan: Choose a few priorities before the next day begins.
htWhy_important: Make progress on one thing that matters to you.
htWhy_distractions: Try one focused period with distractions put aside.
htWhy_desk: Leave your workspace ready for your next session.
htWhy_tidy: Spend a few minutes on one small area.
htWhy_journal: Write a few lines about your day in your own words.
htWhy_reflect: Pause to notice what worked and what to change.
htWhy_skill: Make a little time for deliberate practice.
htWhy_expenses: Review your actual spending and record it yourself.
htWhy_budget: Set aside a weekly moment to check your own plan.
htWhy_quiet: Choose a short quiet or reflective practice that suits you.
htWhy_rest: Step away briefly and return with intention.
hgUnit: For a quantity habit, enter a unit such as pages or minutes. You can leave this blank for a yes/no habit. Then tap Next.
rDuplicateExplain: This is the same file. Open the existing book or deliberately add another copy.
rEmptyLibrary: Your library is ready. Import a PDF, EPUB or TXT file, or try the original Bilga sample.
rErrorChanged: The chosen file differs from the original. Choose the same file to preserve your reading locations.
rErrorCorrupt: This document could not be read safely. It may be damaged or contain unsupported content.
rErrorEmpty: This file contains no readable content.
rErrorEncoding: Save this text as UTF-8 or UTF-16 with a byte-order mark, then import it again.
rErrorLarge: This file exceeds safe limits: PDF 1 GB; EPUB 256 MB compressed and expanded; text or individual EPUB entry 16 MB.
rErrorProtected: Password-protected or DRM-protected books are not supported. Choose an unprotected copy you are authorized to read.
rErrorUnavailable: The file is unavailable. Check its location and access permission. You can relink the original file.
rErrorUnsupported: Use PDF, EPUB or TXT. HTML and FB2 support text only; DOCX and RTF are not supported.
rGuideChoose: Choose a supported file in Android’s picker. Cancel safely to return; no book is created until validation succeeds.
rGuideImport: Tap Import a book. Android’s file picker will open.
rGuideRead: Your book was imported. Tap Read on its card to open the actual reader.
rHelpText: Import a local PDF, EPUB or TXT to start reading. A private encrypted copy is the default. Advanced organization includes external references and optional book details. PDF text selection works when embedded text and copy permissions are available; scanned pages can have page notes. EPUB is reflowed with local images; publisher CSS, audio, video and scripts are not rendered. HTML and FB2 are text-only. Save bookmarks, highlights and cards separately from the original file. Full encrypted backups include managed files; metadata backups require you to relink originals. Reading settings and help work offline.
rLibraryPurpose: Your books, ready to read. Import a file and continue where you stopped.
rNoActivity: Reading activity will appear here after you spend time reading.
rNoMatches: No matching text. Scanned PDFs may contain images only; OCR is not included.
rNoReadingNotes: Save a bookmark or select a passage in the reader. Cards and reviews are optional.
rNotesPurpose: Your bookmarks, highlights, notes and study cards stay linked to this book. Export shares reading data; use encrypted backup for complete recovery.
rPagedHint: Pinch to zoom and pan this page. Switch off page-by-page mode to select and highlight PDF text.
rReviewFinished: No more due cards in this batch. Return later for your next review.
rSamplePreview: Add the original Bilga reading sample to your library? It is a short, freely reusable demonstration text, not a purchased book.
rSaveRetry: Reading data could not be saved. Keep this screen open and retry.
rScheduleExplanation: Leitner review: Again resets to 1 day; Hard keeps your box; Good advances one box; Easy advances two. Intervals are 1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 30 and 60 calendar days. Overdue cards remain due. A rating saves an immutable history entry. Up to 100 due cards are shown per batch.
rSessionExplanation: Time is an estimate of foreground reading. It pauses in the background, on other screens, when paused, or after two minutes without interaction. Reading the last page does not finish a book automatically.
rStorageChoice: Default import saves a private encrypted copy. Referencing a device file saves space, but access depends on that file and its provider. Relink the same original if access is lost.
rSampleBody:
Bilga reading sample

This original demonstration text may be freely used and redistributed.

Read a little each day. A useful idea becomes clearer when you explain it in your own words.

Select this passage, save a highlight and create a question card: What helps me remember an idea?

An answer might be: explain it, connect it with experience and review it later.

You can bookmark this paragraph, close the book and continue reading later.
rTemplatePreview: Preview only. Continue to edit; a record is created only when you save.
rGuideNavigate: Use the page or chapter controls to move through the book. The current location saves automatically. Then tap Next.
rGuideAppearance: Open reading settings and adjust typography or theme, then close the settings panel.
rGuideBookmark: Tap the bookmark button. Add an optional label and save. Cancelling does not complete this step.
rGuideHighlight: Long-press readable text and select Highlight in its context menu, choose a color and save. Scanned PDFs allow page notes instead.
rGuideCard: Open the menu and choose Create a card. Pick a type, enter your own content and save; nothing is created on cancel.
rGuideSaved: Saved. Open Bookmarks and cards from the menu to return to the source or review question cards.
rGuideFlip: Tap Show answer to flip the real question card.
rGuideRate: Choose Again, Hard, Good or Easy. Your rating updates the due date and adds one history entry.
rGuideOrganize: Open Organize and advanced options. Choose a shelf filter, or open a book’s details to edit its shelves and tags. Existing reading stays intact.
rContinueHelp: Use Continue reading on a book card. Imported books restore their saved page or paragraph even after closing the reader.
rBackupChoice: Choose what to include. Full encrypted backup streams managed files with reading data. Metadata and reading data only keeps bookmarks, cards, history and file identities, but you must relink original files after restoring. External references always require their originals. Keep enough free space for the encrypted output.
rBackupSize: of managed files, plus encrypted reading data and a small encryption overhead.
rPartialFormat: This format opens as simplified text only. Images, layout, interactive content and publisher styles are not preserved. Continue?
